title: VCAP Verification Request
description: Sent by the marketplace to the verifier engine to initiate independent delivery verification.

message_type.description: Discriminator for the VCAP message type.

verification_id.description: Unique identifier for this verification job, generated by the marketplace.

negotiation_id.description: The negotiation this verification is for.

spec.description: Verification specification that instructs the verifier what and how to check.

url.description: URL the verifier must navigate to in order to confirm delivery.

selector.description: CSS selector to extract specific content from the page. Null means extract full page content.

expected_content.description: Substring that must appear in extracted content for verification to pass (case-insensitive). Null skips content matching.

fingerprint_delta.description: If true, the verifier checks that the page fingerprint has changed from a prior recorded state.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds the verifier may spend on this job before reporting TIMEOUT.

context.description: Contextual metadata binding this verification to the originating escrow and negotiation.

marketplace.description: Identifier of the marketplace dispatching the verification.

escrow_ref.description: escrow_id of the escrow hold this verification is settling.

negotiation_id.description: Matches the top-level negotiation_id for cross-reference.

verification_id.description: Matches the top-level verification_id for self-referential binding.

requested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the marketplace dispatched this verification request.
